messages:
Jon (Support): FYI two incoming tickets that look like the same ask. INC-7241 (Acme) and SREQ-339 (BetaCorp). Both want automatic graceful fallback when primary model hits capacity.
Maya (Product): can you paste the exact customer asks? Thinking we should merge into a canonical 'model-fallback-policy' request and set owner.
Jon (Support): here's the snippets:
> Acme: 'when hosted model is at capacity, fall back to a compatible cheaper variant with warning headers and consistent log of mismatches.'
> BetaCorp: 'need guaranteed behavior for model variant fallback + visibility in logs and SLA chart.'
Sam (Solutions): both are enterprise tenants on Dedicated pools, not just hosted. That changes cost/priority.
Leo (Eng): dev notes: fallback has two parts: routing fallback (compatible variants) and client-facing messaging. Routing is doable short term; consistent artifacting/logging needs infra change.
Maya (Product): impact? Would this be P1 for customers?
Nina (CS): Acme threatened to pause rollout without this; BetaCorp is asking for contract language. I'd set high.
Leo (Eng): ETA rough: routing fallback in ~2 sprints; full telemetry/logging ~1 quarter. Need an owner for scope negotiation.
Maya (Product): I'll own the canonical request. Proposal:
- Label: triage/duplicate, prio/P1, domain/sla
- Canonical ticket: PROD-882
- Scope: 1) routing fallback to compatible model variants + config knob 2) add fallback events to request logs/console 3) docs + customer-facing template
Jon (Support): pls add response template to notify customers
Maya (Product): Response template:
```
Hi <customer>,

Thanks for the report. We're consolidating duplicate requests into PROD-882 (owner: Maya). Short term: we'll enable automatic routing fallback to a compatible variant (ETA ~2 sprints). Longer term: logging/metrics and SLA contract language (ETA next quarter). We'll follow up when rollout plan is set.

If you need an earlier workaround, we can provide a config to pin the tenant to a specific variant or enable burst capacity for a short period.

Best,
The Redwood team
```
support-bot: linked INC-7241 -> https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/INC-7241
support-bot: linked SREQ-339 -> https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/SREQ-339
Nina (CS): sending customer note now with the template :white_check_mark:
Maya (Product): assigning owner & adding to roadmap board. PROD-882 -> lane: 'backlog' -> note: 'needs infra + product scoping'. ETA: target Q2. :thumbsup:
Jon (Support): thanks!
